A wall-mounted 'Day Case Unit' sign above a wooden door frame at The Wellington Hospital, filmed from below as the camera moves closer and angles up toward the lettering.

Low-angle view of a 'Day Case Unit' sign mounted above a wooden door frame in a hospital corridor at The Wellington Hospital, with the camera arcing beneath it.
Low-angle view of a ceiling-mounted 'Day Case Unit' sign above a doorway in a corridor at The Wellington Hospital.
A staff member fits an orthopaedic walking boot onto the foot of a patient sitting on a hospital bed in a gown and robe, then smiles and talks with him in a patient room at The Wellington Hospital.
A clinician fits an orthopaedic walking boot to the lower leg of a patient sitting on a hospital bed in a gown and yellow grip socks, adjusting the boot around the foot and ankle.

A male patient in a hospital gown and white robe sits on the bed in a private patient room and smiles. A staff member then fits a cold compression wrap to his lower leg as part of post-operative care.

A staff member in a navy polo fits a knee brace or cold compression device to the leg of a patient sitting up in a hospital bed in a private room by the window. The patient, in a gown and yellow grip socks, chats with her during post-operative care after knee surgery.

Low-angle close-up of a female staff member with a blonde ponytail and dark polo shirt with a name badge, looking down and smiling as she talks to someone or works on something out of frame, with a bright window and city buildings behind her.
A staff member in dark scrubs fastens the straps of a hinged knee brace on the leg of a patient lying on a hospital bed in a gown, in a patient room. The patient's face is not shown.

A staff member in a navy polo shirt with a name badge stands and smiles while talking with a seated male patient in a hospital gown and glasses in a patient room with a large window. Both are laughing during the conversation.

A patient in a white robe and hospital gown sits on a bed in a patient room with his leg in an orthopaedic walking boot in the foreground, as a staff member in a navy polo shirt walks up beside the bed.

A staff member adjusts an orthopaedic walking boot on a patient's leg while the patient, in a hospital gown and robe, sits up in bed and talks in a private room at The Wellington Hospital. Focus shifts between the boot and the patient.
A staff member fits an orthopaedic walking boot onto a patient's foot as the patient, in a hospital gown and yellow grip socks, sits on the bed in a patient room and watches.

A patient in a hospital gown and white robe sits up in bed in a private room, smiling and talking, while a staff member in a dark top prepares an orthopaedic walking boot at the foot of the bed. The patient is wearing yellow grip socks, and the focus shifts from the patient to the boot.

Low-angle shot of a female staff member in a dark polo shirt with a name badge, hair tied back, looking down as she works at something just below the frame. A ceiling and a bright window are behind her.

A physiotherapist in a navy uniform fits and fastens the straps of a hinged knee brace on a patient's leg as they lie on a hospital bed. This post-operative orthopaedic rehabilitation care takes place at The Wellington Hospital.

A female staff member with a blonde ponytail, wearing a navy HCA Healthcare UK polo shirt and name badge, looks down at something out of frame and smiles, then turns to talk to someone to her side. Filmed from a low angle in a bright room with large windows at The Wellington Hospital.
A staff member in navy scrubs fits an orthopaedic walking boot to a patient's lower leg and fastens the Velcro strap while the patient lies on a hospital bed.
A male patient in glasses and a hospital gown sits up in bed by a window in a patient room, talking and smiling. The camera then moves down to his clasped hands resting on the gown.
A patient in a white dressing gown uses a knee scooter to walk along a hospital corridor while a staff member in a navy HCA polo shirt walks alongside, supporting his mobility and recovery.
shots.text_on_screen: HCA logo on staff polo shirt

shots.description: A patient in a white dressing gown uses a knee scooter to walk along a hospital corridor while a staff member in a navy polo walks beside him, smiling and supporting his mobility. The camera tracks backwards as they move toward it, ending on their legs and the scooter wheels.

A male patient in a white gown uses a knee scooter to walk down a hospital corridor alongside a staff member in a dark polo shirt, likely a physiotherapist. The clip then shows the same patient, now dressed, sitting on his bed in a patient room while a nurse in a blue uniform goes through a printed document with him, with the knee scooter beside the bed.

A nurse hands paperwork to a male patient sitting on the edge of his hospital bed in a patient room, and he looks over it and talks with her. A rollator walking frame stands beside the bed and there is a window behind them.

A male patient in glasses and a green fleece sits on his bed in a patient room at The Wellington Hospital, talking, then smiles as a nurse hands him a sheet of paperwork. A walking frame stands beside the bed and there is a window behind him.

A patient in a green knit jumper sits on a hospital bed in a private room, holding papers and smiling as he talks with a staff member in a navy uniform holding a clipboard. The camera moves in from a medium shot to a close-up of the patient's face, with a window and city buildings behind him.
Over-the-shoulder shot of a nurse in a light blue HCA tunic smiling and talking with a person in the foreground while holding a tablet or folder, in a doorway with a frosted glass door behind her.

A nurse in an HCA Healthcare UK uniform holds a clipboard and pen and talks with a man wearing glasses, filmed over his shoulder in a hospital corridor by a doorway. She smiles and chats as she checks in with him.
shots.text_on_screen: HCA Healthcare UK logo on uniform

shots.description: A nurse in a blue HCA tunic holding a tablet smiles and talks with a man in glasses who holds paperwork, in a hospital corridor at The Wellington Hospital. The camera moves from her face down to her hands as she writes on the tablet.

A man with glasses passes out of focus in the foreground of a corridor, revealing a waiting area with a black leather sofa, a console table with potted plants and a sculpture, and framed artwork on the wall.
Camera moves past potted plants and a sculpture on a console table in a waiting area with framed black and white artwork, then reveals the wider waiting room where a woman sits looking at her phone.

A man sits in an armchair reading a newspaper in a waiting lounge with a coffee machine in the foreground. The camera tracks right past him to a window with a sculpture and plant, looking out over nearby apartment blocks.

Camera tracks right through a hospital waiting lounge past a coffee machine, showing a woman seated on her phone and a man reading a newspaper among armchairs, framed artwork and shelving with plants.

A man sits in an armchair reading a newspaper in a waiting area at The Wellington Hospital. The camera moves right past a ring sculpture on the windowsill to a view of the neighbouring flats, railway tracks and a car park outside.
Camera tracks sideways past a coffee station in a hospital waiting area at The Wellington Hospital, where a woman sits looking at her phone and a man sits reading a newspaper by the window.
A man in glasses and a dark green fleece sits in a waiting lounge reading a newspaper and turning its pages, with framed abstract artwork on the wall behind him.

Lateral tracking shot across a hospital waiting lounge, moving past a coffee machine on a counter. A woman sits looking at her phone and a man reads a newspaper on chairs beside shelving with plants and artwork.

A man in glasses and a green fleece sits in an armchair in a hospital waiting area at The Wellington Hospital, reading a newspaper. The camera pushes in from a wide view of the seating area by the window to a medium shot of him turning the pages.

Camera moves along a corridor wall at The Wellington Hospital, passing framed abstract and line-drawing prints, black-and-white architectural photographs and potted green plants under circular pendant lights.

An empty waiting area at The Wellington Hospital with armchairs, shelving with plants and vases, a ring sculpture on the windowsill and a view of nearby buildings. The camera moves toward a framed abstract painting in blue tones on the wall and ends close on it.
A patient in a white robe lies on a scanner table with her arms raised above her head while a radiographer in a burgundy tunic stands beside the scanner and prepares the scan.

A staff member in a maroon tunic turns a dial on a curved white wall unit while a woman in a white waffle robe lies with her eyes closed in a white treatment pod. The camera moves from the staff member to the resting patient.
A female patient in a white robe lies on a CT scanner table with her arms raised above her head while a radiographer uses the controls on the gantry to position her for a scan.
A patient in a white robe lies on a scanner table with her arms raised above her head while a staff member in a maroon tunic positions her before an imaging scan.

A woman in a white waffle robe lies on a scanner table with her eyes closed and arms raised above her head as red laser positioning lines cross her face and body. She moves towards the scanner gantry while a staff member's hand is briefly visible at the start.

A radiographer in a maroon tunic presses the controls on a Siemens Healthineers CT scanner while a woman lies on the scanner table with her head on a cushion, ready to move into the bore. Filmed in the imaging suite at The Wellington Hospital.

A female patient in a white waffle robe lies on the table of a CT scanner with her eyes closed while a staff member in scrubs adjusts the controls on the gantry and a red positioning laser shows across her body. The camera moves sideways past the scanner ring, keeping the patient in view.

A woman lies on an MRI scanner table wrapped in a white blanket with her eyes closed as she moves into the bore. The view then shifts to look through the bore at her head, which is positioned in a head coil.

View from inside a scanner bore looking back at a patient lying on the table, their head resting in a cushioned head support with part of their face visible through the opening. The camera slowly rolls as the bore curves around the frame.
View from inside a scanner bore looking out through the opening towards the patient table, where an empty head support sits at the entrance, with the imaging room visible behind.

View looking into an MRI scanner bore from behind as the camera pushes toward a head coil on the scanner table, with a patient's head partly visible through the coil opening. The scanner room is dimly lit.

A staff member in maroon scrubs sits at a control room workstation reviewing chest CT scans on several monitors, alongside a live video feed of the procedure room, while a colleague watches from the foreground. The camera moves around him and he turns to speak with his colleague.

A radiographer in maroon scrubs sits at a CT control room workstation reviewing chest CT images and 3D reconstructions, with a live camera view of the scanner room, while a colleague watches beside him.

Two staff in maroon scrubs sit at a control desk reviewing CT scan images on a monitor, with a camera feed of the treatment room on the screen behind them. The man turns to smile at his colleague, then points a pen at the scan images as they discuss them.
Two staff members in maroon scrubs review CT and PET-CT chest scan images on workstation monitors in an imaging control room. One points at a lung scan on screen while explaining it to a colleague.
A nurse in a maroon tunic leans over a seated patient in a white robe in a patient room. She hands him back a handheld remote after he shows her how to use it.
A staff member in a burgundy tunic adjusts a screen on a swing arm, then hands a remote control to a smiling patient in a white robe seated in a reclining chair in a patient room.

A staff member in a maroon tunic hands a patient in a white bathrobe a handset and reclines her treatment chair so she can rest with her feet up. The patient sits relaxed in a private treatment room at The Wellington Hospital.

A staff member in maroon scrubs talks with a patient in a white robe as she reclines in a treatment chair in a private treatment room, pointing across the room as he explains something. The camera moves past a doorway into the room.
Low-angle moving shot along a corridor wall at The Wellington Hospital, passing an illuminated X-ray warning light to a wall sign with a left arrow reading 'PET CT Department'.
Wall-mounted sign reading 'PET CT Department' with a left-pointing arrow in a corridor at The Wellington Hospital. The camera arcs around the sign from a low angle to a front-on view.

A wall sign reading 'PET CT Department' with a left arrow, then the camera pans left to reveal an empty waiting area with armchairs, small round tables and a wall-mounted TV at The Wellington Hospital.

Gimbal move through an empty waiting area at The Wellington Hospital, passing a wall-mounted screen showing an HCA Healthcare UK 'Welcome to The Wellington Hospital' message and ending on armchairs, side tables, plants and framed artwork.
shots.text_on_screen: HCA Healthcare UK - Welcome to The Wellington Hospital - hcahealthcare.co.uk - Wellington Hospital South

shots.description: Empty patient waiting area with grey and blue armchairs around small round tables, framed black-and-white photographs on the walls and a wall-mounted screen showing a building image. The camera glides right across the lounge seating.

Empty patient waiting area at The Wellington Hospital with grey and blue armchairs, a small table with tissues and magazines, framed artwork and a wall-mounted screen showing HCA Healthcare UK branding. The camera moves smoothly forward from a wide view of the seating towards the large artwork and screen.
shots.text_on_screen: HCA Healthcare UK - The Wellington Hospital (on wall screen, partially legible)

shots.description: Raised lettering reading 'Imaging Department' on a curved white wall at The Wellington Hospital, with a corridor and ceiling lights behind. The camera arcs around from an angled view of the sign to a straight-on view.

A staff member sits at a desk below an 'Imaging Department' wall sign, looking down at her work, with shelves of files and green storage boxes beside her. The camera moves up to the sign and back down, ending with her only partly in frame.
kit: shelving with files and storage boxes

shots.description: The shot opens on an 'Imaging Department' wall sign at The Wellington Hospital, moves to a smiling staff member in a blazer and name badge seated at a reception desk, and ends at a cafe counter where a server in a waistcoat plates a cinnamon bun beside a glass cake dome.
A cafe server in a waistcoat and tie places a cinnamon bun on a plate at the counter of Cafe 78. The camera rises to show her smiling at the camera while a colleague works behind her.
A smiling cafe staff member in a waistcoat and tie serves a pastry on a plate across the counter at Cafe 78, with a card payment terminal and food display case on the counter.

A cafe staff member in a waistcoat and tie slides a plate with a cinnamon bun across the counter at Cafe 78, The Wellington Hospital. The camera moves in from behind a straw dispenser and a glass-domed cake stand.
